answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 10998 Country: India Title: Assalamu alaikum rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. After salam-e-masnoon I have to state that star having six angles is used as religious symbol by jews. We want to print six angles star & moon in the covering cloth of Janazah. Is it permissible? Wassalam Imdadullah Question: Assalamu alaikum rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. After salam-e-masnoon I have to state that star having six angles is used as religious symbol by jews. We want to print six angles star & moon in the covering cloth of Janazah. Is it permissible? Wassalam Imdadullah Answer ID: 10998 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 399/100=TH/1430) It is unlawful, you must not do it. The janazah cover sheet should be white and simple free from writings and designs like star, moon etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
